mira: Heads up — mobile onboarding smoke test uncovered a weird pattern: Android sample's background sync floods the API after connectivity flips. Repo: https://git.redwood.dev/android-sync (branch: bg-sync-fix)
jon: Summary? network flaps + retries?
mira: Exactly. The sample schedules prefetch retries on connectivity regained, but it doesn't respect in-flight backpressure. When device reconnects after stale period it fires N sync jobs (one per document) immediately; each job does authIfNeeded and many trigger concurrent refreshes and immediate retries -> 429 storm. Excerpt logs:
```
[2025-02-08T08:12:01Z] network lost
[2025-02-08T08:12:59Z] network restored
[2025-02-08T08:13:00Z] sync job: doc_42 start
[2025-02-08T08:13:00Z] auth refresh start (thread-7)
[2025-02-08T08:13:00Z] sync job: doc_43 start
[2025-02-08T08:13:01Z] GET /v1/embeds 429
[2025-02-08T08:13:01Z] immediate retry -> GET /v1/embeds 429
```
aza: Sounds similar to other SDK races but mobile flavor: background services + connectivity retries. Are we recreating client per doc?
mira: The sample did. Quick local patch: reuse single ApiClient for background sync service, add a JobQueue with maxConcurrent=3 and an auth single-flight mutex. That removed the immediate concurrent refreshes.
jon: Good. Mobile-specific mitigations to propose in SDK: (1) default background-sync concurrency to 2, (2) a reconnect debounce (2500ms) to coalesce multiple triggers, (3) persistent auth cache + single-flight refresh, (4) add client-side token-bucket limiter for background workers, (5) opt-in 'bgSync.throttleMode = "coalesce"' that enqueues instead of immediate retries.
mobile-bot: monitor: applied soft-throttle to org:mobile-pilot for 60s after 1200 reqs/min spike :warning:
mira: Can you paste the debounce + queue pattern? others find it handy.
aza: snippet (Kotlin):
```kotlin
class SyncService(private val api: ApiClient) {
  private val queue = Semaphore(2)
  private var debounceJob: Job? = null
  fun onNetworkRestore() {
    debounceJob?.cancel()
    debounceJob = GlobalScope.launch {
      delay(2500)
      processPending()
    }
  }
  private suspend fun processPending() {
    pendingDocs.chunked(100).forEach { batch ->
      batch.map { doc ->
        async { queue.withPermit { syncDoc(doc) } }
      }.awaitAll()
    }
  }
}
```
jon: Nice. Let's also add an integration test that simulates network down/up and asserts no >3 concurrent outbound requests and no >1 concurrent auth refresh. Mira can add to android-samples/tests.
mira: I'll open PR: "android-sample: bg sync debounce + queue + auth single-flight" and a follow-up SDK patch (android-sdk v0.6.3) to default these lightweight guards.
opsbot: deploy-bot: PR 3345 created in android-sdk, CI queued :rocket:
jon: After PR merges, run staged device tests with flaky network to validate. I'll run a short soak and watch quota metrics.
mira: Thanks — also adding onboarding note: "mobile: prefer shared ApiClient in background services; avoid per-item client creation". Follow-up in one week to review metrics. :thumbsup:
